syllabus_title: WAEC SSCE Refrigeration and Air-Conditioning Detailed Syllabus

sections.title: Safety and First Aid in the Workshop

subtopics: Helmet, goggles, safety boots, hand gloves, overall, apron, sand bag, fire extinguishers, etc.
Materials for First Aid, charts, posters and first aid box, etc.
Application of first aid materials

practical: Identification and operation of various types of fire extinguishers

sections.title: Energy, Matter and Power

subtopics: Definition of energy
Process of energy conversion (electrical to mechanical, gas to vapour, mechanical to heat)
Meaning of internal energy
Enthalpy of a fluid substance
p-h diagram of refrigerant
State of matter – solid, liquid, gas or vapour
Change of state of matter
Meaning of power
Calculation of power used by a compressor
Unit of power: watts and kilowatts; unit of heat: joules and kilojoules

practical: Demonstration of conversion of mechanical to heat energy e.g. rubbing of palms
Demonstrate the conversion of ice block to water

sections.title: Temperature and Pressure

subtopics: Concept of temperature
Different types of thermometer (gas, resistance, liquid, thermocouple)
Temperature scale conversion (Centigrade to Fahrenheit, Celsius to Kelvin, Fahrenheit to Rankine)
International practical temperature scales
Plotting various temperature scales
Concept of pressure
Different types of pressure measuring devices (barometer, manometer, bourdon tube gauge)
Pressure measurement
Uses of suction and high pressure gauges
Effects of temperature, pressure and volume in refrigeration and air conditioning systems
Gas laws (Boyle’s law, Charles’ law, Dalton’s law)
Calculations involving general gas law

practical: Demonstration of the use of a barometer
Demonstrate how suction and high pressure gauges are used to determine the performance of a refrigerant

sections.title: Refrigeration and Air Conditioning Systems

subtopics: Refrigeration cycle – Evaporation, compression, condensation and expansion
Layout diagram of refrigeration systems
Types and applications of the various forms of refrigeration
Principles of operation of refrigeration systems
Functions of components and accessories (relay, solenoid valves, capacitors, thermostat)
Definition and types of refrigerants
Chemical names and formulae
Properties and uses of refrigerants
Refrigerant flow controls (TEV, AEV, capillary tube)
Operations of refrigerant flow controls
Psychrometric properties of air
The processes of air conditioning: heating and cooling
Latent and sensible heat, saturated and super-saturated vapour

practical: Identification of refrigerant by cylinder colours
Demonstration of air conditioning principle by sling psychrometer
Demonstration of the difference between latent and sensible heat by use of methylated spirit on human skin

sections.title: Compressors, Condensers and Evaporators

subtopics: Types of compressors
Construction of compressors
Working principles of compressors
Construction of condensers
Calculation of heat load on condensers
Types and functions of liquid receiver and service valves
Principle of operation of liquid receiver and service valves
Types of evaporators
Construction and services of evaporators
Working principles of evaporators
Heat load estimates on evaporators

practical: Demonstrate how to service a condenser

sections.title: Workshop Practices

topics.topic: Basic tools used in refrigeration and air-conditioning workshops
subtopics: Basic tools – hacksaw, coil spring benders, reamers, tube cutters, etc.
Different methods of diagnosing faults (systematic and observation)
Common faults in refrigeration systems and their symptoms (leakage, faulty units, faulty compressor, poor cooling, current leakage)
Techniques of effective repairs
Techniques of trouble shooting in a given system
Testing for leakages, polarity, insulation continuity, pressure and efficiency
Maintenance of compressors, evaporators, motors, condensers, valves, accumulators and contactors

practical: Demonstrate how to test for leakages, polarity continuity and efficiency
Demonstrate how to repair faults in compressors, evaporators, motors and condensers

subtopics: Concept of piping, ducting and trunking
Piping a condenser and an evaporator
Ducting, trunking and installation of air-conditioners
Piping, ducting and trunking tools (mallet hammer, flaring tools, silver tape, dot-punch, bending spring, amaflex, hacksaw, PVC pipes)
Types, functions, operations and application of motors and generators
Installation procedures for motors and generators
Maintenance of motors and generators in a refrigeration system
Working principles of cold room
Cold room installation procedures
Factors affecting cold room operations

topics.topic: Insulation of refrigeration and air-conditioning system
subtopics: Importance of insulation
Types of insulating materials (glasswool, fibre glass, polystyrene foam, wood, bitumen, ceramic, etc.)
Functions and properties of insulation materials
Procedure for insulating refrigeration and air-conditioning systems

sections.title: Entrepreneurship

subtopics: Concept of business enterprise and types of businesses (sole proprietorship, partnership, limited liability, etc.)
Sources of finance (loan, mortgage, shares, overdrafts, savings, etc.)
Types and functions of marketing styles
Meaningful marketing at the least cost
Marketing protocol and cost
Principles of Accounting
The concept of business as a separate entity
Ledger, trial balance and balance sheet

practical: Carry out a commercial marketing survey to set up refrigeration and air-conditioning business
Preparation of ledger and balance sheet
